at: After the marriage the five tribes sit in Tabal
alt: High crane: the five Jolbon chieftains sit on five animal hides around one fire in Tabal's hall — crow feathers, horse, cow, pig, dog
scene: HEEWON STYLE watercolor painting, minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop with nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Night inside Tabal's timber hall at Jolbon: packed-earth floor, rough timber posts, a smoke hole in the dark roof, ONE low fire pit at the exact centre as the only light. High crane angle looking steeply down. ONE device: FIVE ANIMAL HIDES laid flat on the earth floor in a ring around the fire like five petals, each a different skin: a spread mat of glossy BLACK CROW FEATHERS; a chestnut HORSE hide with a strip of black mane; a brown-and-white COW hide; a bristly dark grey-black PIG hide; a shaggy pale grey-white DOG pelt. EXACTLY FIVE men, one sitting cross-legged on each hide, facing the fire, nobody else in the hall: Yeon Tabal on the crow feathers (red headband, black beard); the Horse Ka, heavy and bearded, dark robe with a red sash, on the horse hide; the Cow Ka, youngest, red headband and white feathers in his long hair, on the cow hide; the Pig Ka, thick and heavy, on the pig hide; the Dog Ka, the eldest, white beard and grey headband, on the dog pelt. FACES ONLY from the attached chieftain portraits: IGNORE the tiger pelts and bear heads drawn on the portraits — nobody wears a tiger or bear skin; they wear plain hemp and leather tunics, wrapped forearms and their headbands, and the only animal skins in the frame are the five hides on the floor. Unstrung bows lie flat beside them. They lean in and argue — one stabbing a finger at the dirt, one with arms folded, one laughing, one weighing with his palms — not posing. Ember-orange firelight as the one hard key from below, faces carved out of total darkness, the five men's long shadows thrown outward across the floor like spokes, smoke rising into black. Background and foreground are a Renaissance tenebrist oil painting: umber-to-black timber posts and earth floor modelled in glazed oil, sfumato into black at the frame edges, a dark out-of-focus post in one foreground corner; the webtoon figures are painted into that oil space in watercolor washes under the same fire key.

at: Goguryeo works like this: five Commanderies argue as Commanders
alt: Straight down on the High Summit: five commanders at a pentagon table inlaid with the three-legged crow, five swords planted behind them under five crimson banners

Behind each man one ring-pommel sword plunged upright in the floor (five swords total) and one long crimson banner (five banners).
